manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Shows a tossed ball rising, pausing at the top, then falling while gravity always pulls down.
manifest.description: A ball is launched upward. Its velocity arrow shortens as it rises, disappears at the instant the velocity is zero, and points down while falling. A constant gravity arrow points down at all times. Callout text indicates the motion state and that gravity pulls down.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s², no air resistance, up is positive.
